subfiles.about: Dr. E. I. M. Dickson protests American supplies of scrap iron, gasoline, and munitions to Japan while civilians are being bombed in Canton.
subfiles.summary: Dr. E. I. M. Dickson protests that the U.S. condemns the bombing of Canton yet supplies Japan with gasoline, scrap iron and munitions.
